messages:
ashley (infra): Heads-up — ap-southeast1 warmnode heartbeats started flapping around 08:12 UTC. Seeing ~1.2k tiny-pod evictions in the last 20m.

ravi (scheduler): looking now. scheduler telemetry shows a spike in lease-heartbeat misses; ~10% of leases in that warmpool are in `fence` state and getting rebind attempts.

chris (sre): any network errors correlated? conntrack or SYN/RST spikes?

jen (runtime): I see repeated TCP RST between scheduler and node-agent during a short window at ~07:58. grabbing log snippet:
```
node-agent[1278]: heartbeat timeout (last=2026-03-22T07:58:10Z) -> fence
scheduler[2240]: rebind request node=worker-az3-12 lease=lp-32416 status=FENCE
kubelet[45]: drain start due to lease-fence for tiny-pod/gpu-lite-7d9
```

ashley (infra): deploy-bot shows a nodepool rolling upgrade in that AZ at 07:58 — could have bumped iptables/kube-proxy timing.

ravi (scheduler): probable chain: upgrade -> brief control-plane latency -> node-agent heartbeat latency -> scheduler marks leases as FENCE -> scheduler action rebinds/removes pod bindings -> tiny pods get evicted and rescheduled -> warmpool gets drained faster than it can rewarm -> cascade.

chris (sre): cost note: because warmpool drained the last 30m we've spilled to on-demand GPUs in that region. Back-of-envelope: ~+2.6k USD/day if sustained. Need short-term mitigation.

jen (runtime): short-term mitigations I can deploy: increase node-agent heartbeat timeout to 45s for az3 warmpool and temporarily disable "drain-on-fence" for pods labeled `tiny-gpu:true`. Will do a canary.

ashley (infra): @ravi can you push a scheduler canary to increase lease grace to 60s for az3? Also let's add a route rule to prefer eu-west fallback for non-latency-sensitive jobs.

ravi (scheduler): doing both. will push to 2 warmpool nodes first and emit metric `lease.grace_seconds` for the az. adding a dashboard panel.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: scheduler/leasegrace v2 -> nodes: worker-az3-12, worker-az3-17

chris (sre): quick check after canary: evictions on canary nodes dropped ~80% within 6m. Network errors still present but the extra grace avoids immediate fence churn.

ashley (infra): good. if canary holds, roll to remainder of az. also we should activate transient soft-reserve on warmpool to reduce spillover on short blips. need PM sign-off for cross-region fallback.

jen (runtime): agreed. recommended config snippet for immediate apply (canary-friendly):
```
warmpool:
  soft_reserve: 0.15
  heartbeat_seconds: 45
  drain_on_fence: false # for tiny-gpu pods during upgrade window
```

ravi (scheduler): rolling change to rest of az now. ETA ~10m to finish. Adding metric `fence->rebind.rate` to alert if >5/min.

ashley (infra): follow-ups: ops postmortem to capture root cause (nodepool upgrade interop with kube-proxy + heartbeat timing), add upgrade simulation to autoheal tests, and document soft-reserve as a knob. I'm filing the ticket now.

chris (sre): filed as ENGPLAT-4312. linking logs and cost impact. :thumbsup:

ashley (infra): thanks team — monitoring closely.
